title.zh: 2026 AI 就绪度：从实验到规模化的鸿沟
title.en: AI Readiness 2026: Bridging the Experiment-to-Scale Gap

summary.zh: 我们的全球调研显示，87% 的企业仍处于 AI 实验阶段。本文分析规模化落地的五大障碍及跨越路径。
summary.en: Our global survey reveals 87% of enterprises remain in AI experimentation. This article analyzes the five barriers to scaling and the paths across.

title.zh: 平台工程的 ROI：从减负到加速
title.en: Platform Engineering ROI: From Toil Reduction to Acceleration

summary.zh: 基于对 40+ 北美企业的平台工程投资分析，我们量化了 IDP 的三年投资回报率与关键成功因素。
summary.en: Based on analysis of 40+ North American platform engineering investments, we quantify three-year IDP ROI and key success factors.

title.zh: 职能型到产品型：亚洲企业技术组织转型实录
title.en: Functional to Product: Inside Asian Enterprise Tech Org Transformations

summary.zh: 三家亚洲制造业巨头的技术组织重塑案例，详述从职能竖井到产品导向团队的变革路径与经验教训。
summary.en: Three Asian manufacturing giants' tech org transformations, detailing the path from functional silos to product-oriented teams with lessons learned.

title.zh: 数据网格在金融服务中的实践：不止于架构模式
title.en: Data Mesh in Financial Services: More Than an Architecture Pattern

summary.zh: 数据网格不仅是技术架构，更是组织设计选择。本文以欧洲银行为例，探讨实施中的组织与治理挑战。
summary.en: Data mesh is not just a technical architecture but an organizational design choice. Using a European bank case study, we explore org and governance challenges.

title.zh: 零信任不是产品：构建企业安全韧性的系统方法
title.en: Zero Trust Is Not a Product: A Systems Approach to Enterprise Security Resilience

summary.zh: 零信任常被误解为一套产品组合。本文提出以系统思维构建安全韧性，覆盖身份、网络、应用与数据四层。
summary.en: Zero trust is often misunderstood as a product suite. This article proposes a systems-thinking approach to building security resilience across identity, network, application, and data layers.

title.zh: 生成式 AI 在中国制造业的落地现状与未来
title.en: Generative AI Adoption in Chinese Manufacturing: Present and Future

summary.zh: 基于 50+ 家中国制造企业的调研，分析 GenAI 在质量检测、工艺优化与知识管理中的实际应用与挑战。
summary.en: Based on a survey of 50+ Chinese manufacturers, we analyze GenAI applications in quality inspection, process optimization, and knowledge management.

title.zh: 2026 全球数字化投资趋势报告

summary.zh: 年度旗舰报告：覆盖 30 个国家、12 个行业的数字化投资趋势分析，含 AI、云、安全三大赛道的支出预测。
summary.en: Annual flagship report: digital investment trend analysis across 30 countries and 12 industries, including spending forecasts for AI, cloud, and security.

title.zh: 遗留系统现代化的五种模式及选型指南
title.en: Five Patterns for Legacy Modernization and How to Choose

summary.zh: 从重写到绞杀者，我们根据 100+ 项目经验总结五种现代化模式，并提供基于系统特征的选择决策树。
summary.en: From rewrite to strangler fig, we summarize five modernization patterns from 100+ projects and provide a selection decision tree based on system characteristics.

title.zh: 工程师体验即产品：技术组织设计的新范式
title.en: Developer Experience as Product: A New Paradigm for Tech Org Design

summary.zh: 将工程师体验视为产品来管理，正在成为吸引和留住顶尖技术人才的关键差异化因素。本文提出 DevEx 产品管理框架。
summary.en: Treating developer experience as a product is becoming a key differentiator for attracting and retaining top technical talent. This article proposes a DevEx product management framework.

title.zh: 从湖到仓：亚太企业数据架构演进路径
title.en: From Lake to Lakehouse: Data Architecture Evolution in Asia-Pacific

summary.zh: 亚太企业在数据架构上面临独特挑战：多语言数据、跨境合规与混合云。本文提出适配 APAC 的湖仓一体演进策略。
summary.en: APAC enterprises face unique data architecture challenges: multilingual data, cross-border compliance, and hybrid cloud. This article proposes an APAC-adapted lakehouse evolution strategy.
